# irritool

<!-- badges: start -->

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/joaobtj/irritool/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/joaobtj/irritool/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of `irritool` is to provide practical tools and workflows for irrigation engineering, crop water requirements, soil water balance, and hydraulic calculations.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `irritool` from [GitHub](https://github.com/joaobtj/irritool) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("joaobtj/irritool")
```

## Overview

The package is being redesigned to focus on irrigation scheduling and hydraulics.
